text:
maria-sales: Heads-up: Evergreen Health wants a capacity appendix for their enterprise LOI. They asked for recommended reserved GPUs, a short autoscale policy, and answers to a few security questions. Need a concise presales deliverable by EOD.

jon-se: Do we have their traffic profile? steady vs spiky?

maria-sales: They expect 7k RPS peak for chat+embeddings during 09:00-12:00 weekdays, baseline ~1k, short spikes to 9k for ~8 minutes. P95 latency target 350ms.

tara-ml: Model mix ~55% gen, 45% embeddings. Gen avg 100 tokens, context 2048. Plan is int8 quantized gen; embeddings on CPU.

owen-platform: Quick ballpark: to hit 7k sustained with quantized gen and warmed KV, estimate 6 x A10-equivalent workers + 2 embedding workers. If they want AZ redundancy with 99.9% SLA, add 1 extra worker per AZ.

hannah-sre: Ops notes: recommend baseline pool = 1.2x sustained baseline, scale increments of 2 workers, scale cooldown 180s, scale-in delay 10m. For 8min spikes use burst lane (pre-warmed slots) to avoid cold starts.

maria-sales: They asked: can we avoid throttling during 8min spikes without reserving full peak?

jon-se: Options: 1) reserve capacity for full peak (higher monthly cost), 2) reserve baseline + burst credits sized for spike minutes, 3) autoscale with prewarm windows timed before expected peaks. We should present costs for each.

owen-platform: I'll run a short simulator to produce worker counts and a cost delta table. For now, sample math: Reserved monthly = unit_gpu_price * 8 GPUs * hours/month. Burst credits = per-peak-minute unit * spike_minutes. Will fill numbers after run.

tara-ml: Warmup plan: scheduled KV prime 12 minutes before window. Typical per-worker warm prime ~5 minutes if parallelized. Fallback: route to smaller quantized model automatically if p95 exceeds threshold for 30s. Note accuracy drop ~3-5% on conversational metrics.

hannah-sre: Risk to call out: AZ affinity requirements will force overprovision per AZ and reduce effective headroom. Also, if they require single-tenant physical isolation, costs increase and our rollout timeline lengthens.

maria-sales: Security Qs: BYOK KMS, audit log retention, SOC2, private VPC—who owns answers?

owen-platform: I can draft: BYOK supported via customer-managed KMS, audit logs exportable to customer S3 with configurable retention up to 13 months, SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 in compliance pack, VPC/private deployment available.

jon-se: Add note about tenant isolation on dedicated pools and network egress controls.

hannah-sre: Also include an ops playbook item for failover during node eviction: promote warm standby, flush KV, and degrade to smaller model if needed.

maria-sales: Action items: Owen run sim + cost appendix; Tara validate warmup times and accuracy delta; Hannah draft autoscale + failover guidance; Jon assemble security answers with Owen. Target internal review 4:30pm PT.

ops-bot: warmup-job-9907 queued by owen-platform.

owen-platform: starting sim now, will post numbers when complete.

maria-sales: thank you, team — this will seal the LOI if we can show a clear, low-risk plan. :pray:
